hypothesis: The built-in templates, with no game knowledge, die before 5:00 on the Nightmare Daily, and the log shows which damage sources and which minutes do it.
test: Play the templates as they are; change nothing. This is the baseline every later run compares with.
learnings: Baseline templates live far past 5:00 on this daily seed; damage is hot oil and bosses, not crowd.

hypothesis: Taking every chest and shrine in reach makes Tibo stronger faster than it costs in health.
test: planner.state tells the planner to favour chests and charge spots over gems and evading whenever they are within reach, and to pick the highest-damage card.
learnings: E21 partial look; 17-18-06 opened many chests and reached 17:14 with five evolutions. 17-20-20 opened about 32 chests and lived 15:03 with five evolutions by 8:16.

hypothesis: Favouring food, evading, and health and armor cards carries a weak build further than the baseline.
test: planner.state tells the planner to evade whenever enemies are close, eat food under 70% health, and pick health and armor first.

hypothesis: Planning every pick around one evolution, and saving chests until it is ready, beats picking for kill speed now.
test: planner.state names one weapon and its catalyst from the encyclopedia and tells the planner to take only those until the recipe is ready.
learnings: E21 saw Taproot at 2:19; 17-18-06 evolved five weapons without a single-recipe directive. 17-20-20 did the same by 8:16.

hypothesis: Exploring for chests and spots beats collecting xp gems.
test: planner.state favours explore goals over gems; knobs.exploreDistance 600.
learnings: E26 ran exploreDistance 600. Chests were opened from 1:08, and gems goals still ran for long stretches after 4:06 and around 10:14 and 14:09. The gems-versus-explore question is still open.

hypothesis: Not every spot that charges helps: some (a Beetle Nest wakes an elite) cost more than they give.
test: Send Tibo to every kind of spot it meets once, and read the log around each for health, level and enemies after.
learnings: Beetle Nest visits in E21 and 17-03-58. 17-20-20 charged nests at 0:26, 0:32, 0:57 and 3:09 for a few hp. 17-44-47 finished a nest at 3:15 already charged 1 of 1.5 seconds, health stayed 55 on the channel; fry-fly and bowling-ball (10 each on the outcome) hit at 3:17. 18-01-48 charged Beetle Nest at 12:02 at full hp (P556) for a chest and +39 hp Mandoline hit on the tile.

hypothesis: The planner follows a directive written into planner.state: its picks and goals change when the directive does.
test: Write one plain directive into planner.state and count how many picks and goals in the log agree with it.
outcome: E21: 0 evade, 8 chest starts once listed.
learnings: Directive works when chests/food exist; useless before listing. 17-20-20 again: 0 evade goals, chest opens once listed, food under 70%. 18-01-48: 5 food goals, 2 spot goals, 118 explore.

hypothesis: Asking the action model less often (a higher extraDamage) costs little health, because the game's forecast already rules out the worst moves.
test: knobs.extraDamage 0.08 against the baseline 0.02; compare health lost per minute.
learnings: E21 showed forecast-free steps costing hp under chargers. 17-20-20's largest hits (ice-imp 87 and 114, mandoline 64 and 82) were forecast at no damage on the goal direction, so a higher extraDamage still auto-walks them.

hypothesis: When a boss first appears, evading away from it loses less health than going for a chest or gems near it.
test: planner.state evade on boss appear; compare to E1 amusing/grater cases.
learnings: 17-27-39 kept explore through amusing at 2:00; lost hp before first chest. 17-20-20 kept the chest or explore goal through amusing at 2:00 and Colorado Queen at 3:03; neither boss is on the outcome list. 18-32-36 explored away from amusing at 2:00, then at 2:04 opened a chest 94 up-left while amusing was 64 up-left. That channel was dropped at 2:09, and a second chest at 2:14 failed at 2:21.

hypothesis: A weapon that hits all around Tibo without needing a direction (Steam Vent) is a better first weapon on nightmare than whatever card looks strongest.
test: planner.state names Steam Vent first.

hypothesis: Taking Rotten Spud on nightmare ends the run sooner, because the curse brings harder enemies before its evolutions pay off.
test: planner.state take Rotten Spud first.

hypothesis: Telling the action model to leave hot oil, and telling the planner not to evade while no enemy is within 60 and no boss is close, cuts hot-oil damage well below the baseline 274 and still lives past 5:00.
test: action.hurt/useful penalize burn; planner.goal chest over evade when enemies_near 0. Daily only.

hypothesis: A chest Tibo is already opening fails because stand-still is ruled out when staying forecasts more than extraDamage, and offering that step fixes failed opens.
test: Raise extraDamage and praise standing still on charging chest unless die/boss contact.
learnings: E21 chests often opened after step-off; 17-18-06 same pattern. 17-20-20 stepped off at 1:38 and 3:12-3:24 while 0.4 to 0.7 charged; one chest failed at 1:19 and several later opens still completed.

hypothesis: boss:ketchup-kraken and boss:compost-titan are the daily post-freezer killers.
test: Read id/name rows on daily E1.
outcome: Names matched ids; killing blow not in log.
learnings: Ids and spawn order settled on that seed.

hypothesis: The baseline's rises of about 25 to 30 hp with no food goal are a repeating heal on daily.
test: List +10 hp jumps without food on daily.

hypothesis: A completed food goal heals about 30 hp unless a boss hit lands in the same seconds.
test: Record food goal hp on daily.
learnings: 17-20-20 world food at 12:38 healed +31 (131 to 162). The 14:37 food ended at +7 with ice-imp 23.1 on the same stretch.

hypothesis: Grater Golem is a cheap boss minute on gems.
test: Record hp lost first 20s after Grater on daily.

hypothesis: Once charging a spot, switching to a second copy wastes the channel.
test: Planner keeps same spot until done.
learnings: E21 swapped chest goals but still opened. 17-20-20 swapped among listed chests at 1:19-1:31 and still opened the cluster by 1:43. 18-47-09 at 1:53 dropped a Seed Vault at 0.4 of 2 seconds for a Beetle Nest at 61%.

hypothesis: Under built-in templates, nightmare open world matches daily evade-then-gems and hazard-heavy damage.
test: No changes; nightmare world baseline.
learnings: Open world baseline evades, no gems; trash not hazards on that seed.

hypothesis: On nightmare open world, forecast-free steps still lose 2+ hp often.
test: Count no-damage forecast with hp_lost>=2.
outcome: Multiple rows before 3:00 on two seeds.
learnings: Charger and crowd ticks missing from forecast. 17-20-20 adds page walks. 17-44-47 sizzle-imp on priced step. 18-01-48 blight-spore dominance on long run without changing forecast trust knobs.

hypothesis: Chest+food directive gets past 3:16 on nightmare world.
test: E21 directive only.
learnings: Directive works; survival failed on Bog Toad seed. Later seeds with same directive lived 17:14, 15:03, and 16:08.

hypothesis: Daily-style +30 hp jumps do not happen on world in first 3 minutes.
test: List +10 hp without food by 3:00.
learnings: Refute/confirm rules conflict; heal after 3:00 exists on world. 17-20-20 shows jumps before 3:00. B18 disproved for first-3-min absence.

hypothesis: amusing and Colorado Queen put no line on outcome on world.
test: Boss names vs outcome list.
learnings: Amusing can dominate on some seeds only. 17-20-20 left no outcome line for amusing or queen.

hypothesis: Looser action.dash cuts hp lost 1:00–2:30 versus E21.
test: E24 dash + action.state hurt_by/enemies; same knobs as E21 otherwise.
learnings: Dash spends reliably. Champion stack + opening rules reached 16m+ on two seeds (127B4T9 15:03, XZIVVU 16:08); dash alone not isolatable.

hypothesis: Evade under 40% keeps directive from burning last hp.
test: Add evade under 40%, ignore far chests.
learnings: 17-20-20 at 48/192 chose food ~100 away. 18-01-48 used evade at 11:53 at 41 hp successfully.

hypothesis: exploreDistance 600 lists first chest before 1:30.
test: 600 with E21 directive; time of first chest.
learnings: One seed at 600. 18-01-48 at 300: first chest 1:43 on XZIVVU.

hypothesis: Spending gold at Fry Cart/Potato Crate when gold>=100 is worth the walk.
test: planner.state afford shops.
learnings: 17-20-20 bought Coal-Baked Spud at 10:57 and never used it.

hypothesis: Naming Bog Toad charger in action templates cuts its damage.
test: Template warning; compare bog-toad line.
learnings: No bog-toad line on 17-20-20.

hypothesis: Dash yes follows chosen move and worsens 1:00–2:30 hp.
test: Compare dash count and hp vs E21.
learnings: Long runs still dash on chest approach; net survival can improve.

hypothesis: No dash while chest still charging avoids 3:24-style failures.
test: Dash no on charging chest; confirm channel completes.
learnings: Approach dashes remain; 18-01-48 opened many chests without charging-tile dash rows.

hypothesis: ~30 hp heal after 3:00 without food repeats on world.
test: List +10 jumps, no food, no max change after 3:00.
learnings: 17-20-20 multiple jumps with max unchanged.

hypothesis: Amusing large hits often miss in forecast when standing on/near boss.
test: Per amusing hit >=15 hp: forecast vs on-chest.
learnings: 17-20-20 Wireworm and Mandoline page-walk hits. E38. 18-47-09: from 2:15 the model priced the chest direction, where amusing stood, at about -20 to -50 hp. At 2:43 the page walked that direction with amusing 25 away because the one-second forecast called it as cheap as the safest step. The last 3 seconds were amusing 29.9 and cave-grub 14.1.

hypothesis: A chest can raise a held weapon ~3 levels without a pick.
test: Levels before/done on chest open.
learnings: 17-20-20 multiple weapon jumps from chests.

hypothesis: The E21 directive + E24 dash stack alone reaches 15:00 on a majority of nightmare world seeds.
test: Replicate champion loadout on 3 seeds.
learnings: 17:14, 15:03, 16:08 on three seeds; not yet majority tested.

hypothesis: Naming ice-imp/grease-fiend burst contact in action.hurt reduces forecast misses.
test: Add line to action templates.
learnings: 18-01-48: blight-spore 617 top; ice-imp 114 on 16:08 death. Those hits were mostly page walks, so an action.hurt line is never read. E50 tests distrustSeconds 8 instead of more wording. E50 on 18-32-36 died at 2:23 on IXJBKS before either pest. The knob did ask the model after each free hit (8 walks, 15 hp) and opened no chest.

hypothesis: E37 approach dash rule stops high-probability dashes on chest goals.
test: Extend action.dash with hurt_by rule.
outcome: Died 2:59; dashes still 74-89% on chest goal.
learnings: Text approach rule ineffective.

hypothesis: planner.state line 'below 25% hp do not start another chest' prevents second-chest deaths.
test: Add directive line only.
learnings: Motivated by 17-33-44. 18-32-36 started the fatal chest at 37/120 (31%), so a 25% line would not have stopped it.

hypothesis: Empty action.dash on open-chest goals until charging reduces hp lost 50→15 windows.
test: Conditional never-dash on open chest.
learnings: 17-44-47 90% dash on chest approach.

hypothesis: Wireworm and Mandoline deal 50+ hp on forecast-free page walks.
test: List boss hits >=15 hp, mark walk vs model.
learnings: 17-20-20 evidence. 18-01-48 Mandoline 140 outcome; 12:03 channel hit.

hypothesis: A second seed at exploreDistance 600 lists chest before 1:30 above 80% hp.
test: Repeat E26 setup.
learnings: E26 one seed. 18-32-36 at exploreDistance 300 on IXJBKS listed the first chest at 2:04, after amusing, at 62/120.

hypothesis: planner.pick wording shifts shrine and food vs Skip.
test: Add boss-aware and under-70% pick sentences.
learnings: 17-20-20 Skip vs Baked Potato pattern.

hypothesis: First Spud Whetstone charged at 40%+ levels a weapon for under 20 hp.
test: Whetstone-before-chest directive; record listing hp.
outcome: Died 3:44 Z40504; first listing 2:27 at 35% hp; never charged.
learnings: Never reached charge test on Z40504.

hypothesis: Skipping early charge spots and eating food under 70% keeps hp at or above 40% until the first Spud Whetstone is offered.
test: E44 directive on nightmare world; log first whetstone clock and hp.
outcome: Lived 16:08 seed XZIVVU. First chest 1:43. First whetstone in options 7:43 at 112/163 (69%). Spot goals 2. Food goals 5. Never started whetstone.
learnings: Opening skip + food carry health to first whetstone listing on this seed. Whetstone charge and level-up still untested; planner ranked whetstone below explore.

hypothesis: Walking onto a Stray Dog heals ~30 hp.
test: Charge Stray Dog under 80% hp; compare hp before/after.
learnings: 17-44-47 Stray Dog channel vs +30 jump.

hypothesis: sizzle-imp deals 15+ hp on steps forecast under 5 hp.
test: List sizzle-imp hits >=10 vs forecast.
learnings: 17-44-47 one seed.

hypothesis: Adding 'If none of those apply, say no' to action.dash stops spurious yes.
test: Extend dash template.

hypothesis: When a Spud Whetstone is listed and hp is at least 40%, a directive to charge it before any chest or explore makes the planner start that goal.
test: Add a line that says charge the first listed Spud Whetstone before explore, not only before a chest, at 40% health or more. Same knobs and dash templates as 18-01-48.
learnings: E44 showed listing at 69% hp but whetstone max 19% vs explore 21% at 7:59. On 18-32-36 the directive already said charge the first whetstone before any chest. It was on the plan at 0:43 (168 up-right, 15% against explore up 59%, hp 112/120), then 11–13% on later listings, and never started. The sentence has to beat explore.

hypothesis: Naming Beetle Nest as forbidden even after mid-game prevents full-hp nest goals like 12:02.
test: Explicit 'never Beetle Nest' in directive; compare spot goal count and hp around 12:00.
learnings: Motivated by 18-01-48 P556 at 192 hp. 18-32-36 scored a nest at 34% at 1:36 and still explored. The opening ban held on this short run; the mid-game case is still open.

hypothesis: distrustSeconds 8 asks the action model for 8 seconds after each forecast-free hit and cuts follow-up blight-spore and ice-imp damage versus the 16:08 page-walk totals (617 and 114), while chests still open.
test: E44 opening directive and E24 dash, exploreDistance 300, start tater-pup. Only knobs.distrustSeconds changes from 0 to 8. Read walk rows for forecast-not-trusted and compare blight-spore and ice-imp totals with the 16:08 outcome.
outcome: Died 2:23 on IXJBKS, level 8, 260 kills, 106 damage, 0 healed. Eight forecast-free walks totaled 15 hp, each followed by about 8 seconds of rows saying the forecast was not trusted. Damage: amusing 28, hot oil 24, bog-slime 18, ketchup-drop 15, spittlebug 6, aphid 6, sprout-mite 5, oil-drip 4. No blight-spore, no ice-imp. Chests 0 opened, 1 dropped, 1 failed. First chest 2:04.
learnings: The knob does what it says: the page takes the triggering hit, then the action model is asked for about 8 seconds. Eight repeats on this seed. Blight-spore and ice-imp never appeared, so their totals were not measured. Both chest goals were in amusing's direction and never opened. Score the pest totals only on a run that meets those pests.

hypothesis: distrustBossRange 400, with distrustSeconds left at 0, cuts The Mandoline and The Deep Freezer forecast-free hits (140 and 96 on the 16:08 run) because those bosses hit from outside the one-second forecast.
test: E44 planner and E24 dash. Only knobs.distrustBossRange set to 400. Compare mandoline and deep-freezer outcome totals and walk rows while a boss is inside 400.
learnings: Queued so the boss-range knob is not lost while E50 tests pest follow-ups first. 18-01-48 Mandoline 140 and Deep Freezer 96. E50 is done and inconclusive, so this boss-range test is still open and separate. 18-47-09 died on the step this knob would ask: 2:43 page walk, 16 to 5 hp, amusing 25 away, forecast as cheap as the safest step, distrustBossRange 0. The action model had refused that direction since 2:15.

hypothesis: A line in the action templates that names hot oil cuts opening hot-oil damage below the 24 hp IXJBKS took by 2:23.
test: 17:14 champion planner and E24 dash, exploreDistance 300, tater-pup, distrustSeconds 0. The only change is action.state, which says hot oil burns, includes standing_on, and says to step off it, plus one action.hurt sentence that standing in hot oil hurts. Read whether the first burn tick is followed by steps off the oil, and compare the hot oil total with the 24 hp IXJBKS took by 2:23.
outcome: Died 2:43 on YLS7TB, level 8, 321 kills, 154 damage. Hot oil 0. Spore vent 18. Brambles 2.3 on the 1:07 page walk and absent from the outcome list. Hot oil never appears in hurt_by, standing_on or underfoot. 0 chests opened. First chest 2:15. Amusing 54. Six Beetle Nest channels completed.
learnings: Proposed because IXJBKS took 24 hot oil hp by 2:23. The hot-oil lines were in action.state and action.hurt for the whole run. YLS7TB never named hot oil. Spore vent was 18, in 3-second windows of 1.9 at 0:51, 7.2 at 1:30 and 9.1 at 2:00, underfoot spores. The model took the least-forecast step and was still on spores a second later. Three page walks added ticks the template is never shown, because distrustSeconds was 0. A zero hot-oil total is a success only when the log shows the oil was there and was left.

hypothesis: On a run that meets blight-spore and ice-imp, distrustSeconds 8 cuts their totals below the 16:08 figures of 617 and 114, and chests still open.
test: Same stack as E50: E44 directive, E24 dash, exploreDistance 300, tater-pup, distrustSeconds 8. If the run dies before those pests appear, record whether the knob fired and leave the pest totals uncompared.
learnings: E50 showed the 8-second window on a 2:23 death and could not see the pests. The question stays open for a long run.

hypothesis: Skipping a chest when a boss is within about 100, including while health is under 40%, loses less health in the amusing minute than opening that chest.
test: Add one directive line on the champion planner: do not start a chest a boss is standing on, and under 40% health evade or eat instead. Same knobs and dash as 18-01-48. Read the first amusing minute for chest goals and hp lost.
learnings: 18-32-36 opened a chest at 2:04 with amusing 64 away in the same direction, dropped it at 2:09, then failed a chest at 2:21 that started at 37 hp with amusing 37 away. 18-47-09 had no skip line. Chest goals at 2:15 (91 down-left, amusing 134 down-left, 65%), 2:25, 2:28, 2:35 and 2:40. One miss at 2:20 with the chest 299 away (41% vs explore 58%). 0 opened. Minute 2 lost 115. Death on a page walk at 2:43 with amusing 25 away.

hypothesis: A planner.goal question that asks whether the option is the directive-required Spud Whetstone charge (when hp>=40% and a whetstone is listed) raises whetstone votes above explore for that plan call.
test: Keep E48 planner.state; change planner.goal for charge goals to mention directive-first whetstone. Log first whetstone goal start and hp at channel done.
learnings: E48 refuted text-only directive. Isolates B2 per-option scoring vs state wall of text.

hypothesis: planner.goal wording that scores Eat food higher when hp<70% and food is listed causes food goals at 1:43-style moments without dropping explore on champion seeds.
test: Add food line to planner.goal only; compare food goal count and minute-2 hp on 6BZ2E7-class seeds vs XZIVVU.
learnings: Two food goals total. Clear win 7:21 at 49 hp (+24). At 5:37 food listed at 120 hp scored 15% vs fight elite 50%; 9:01 food options lost to explore. planner.goal food sentence insufficient without stronger noul or planner.state.

hypothesis: When no chest is listed by 2:00, switching from pure explore to fight-elite goals (eliteSeconds 20) produces a chest listing sooner than exploreDistance 600 alone on chest-starved seeds.
test: E44 opening + E24 dash, exploreDistance 600 unchanged. Add planner.state: if no chest listed and game time past 2:00, prefer Fight the nearest elite over explore. Compare first chest listing time and hp on 6BZ2E7 or 1UNSC63.
learnings: Motivated by E41: drops are elite/boss-gated; 18-40-20 nest at 2:43 did not yield open before 3:35. 18-47-09 charged six nests and never took Fight the elite, offered from 0:48 at about 25–38% and still losing after 2:00. First chest 2:15 with amusing at 80%, so it was an elite drop, and none of the chest goals opened.

hypothesis: A planner.state line forbidding Beetle Nest until after the first chest opens stops full-hp nest goals at 2:37 without blocking 18-01-48-style late nests.
test: Same stack as E41; add one directive line. Count nest goal starts before first chest open and hp 2:00–3:00.
learnings: 18-40-20: P176 at 106 hp before any chest. 18-47-09 had no nest ban and started six nests before any chest (0:42, 1:08, 1:17, 1:31, 1:53, 2:08), all completed. The 2:08 nest ran during amusing and ended 12 hp down.

hypothesis: After pick, telling planner.state to keep the current open-chest goal prevents dropping C65738 for explore at 3:19.
test: Single sentence in planner.state after chest listed; log goal drops between pick and chest done.
learnings: 18-40-20 pick Peeler then explore over chest at 91 up-left.

hypothesis: planner.goal text that scores fight-elite above explore when game time past 2:00 and no chest is listed causes elite goals in the 2:00-3:00 no-chest window where E54 directive alone failed.
test: Champion stack unchanged. Only planner.goal adds: if no chest in options and seconds>=120, fight listed elite beats explore. Log elite goal starts 2:00-3:15 and first chest time on 6BZ2E7 or 1UNSC63.

hypothesis: Naming Spore vent and Brambles in the action templates, and telling Tibo to step off a tile whose underfoot or last damage is that hazard, makes the next model steps leave it. On a seed that has spore vents, damage from the vent on steps the model is asked falls below the model-step stretch of YLS7TB, where only hot oil was named.
test: Same planner, E24 dash, knobs and tater-pup as 18-47-09, including distrustSeconds 0 and exploreDistance 300. Change only action.state and action.hurt: name Spore vent and Brambles beside hot oil, and say to step off that tile. Inconclusive if the outcome lists none of the three. A zero counts only when the log shows that hazard was there. Page-walk ticks are outside the comparison, because those steps never read the template.
learnings: YLS7TB with a hot-oil-only line: Spore vent 18, hot oil 0. Model steps around 1:28 and 1:58 stayed on spores while the 3-second window climbed to 7.2 and 9.1. A no-damage forecast step at 1:28 was still on spores a second later.

hypothesis: A directive line that forbids a Beetle Nest while any boss is listed stops nest goals during the amusing minute and saves the hp that channel costs.
test: Champion planner plus one line: if a boss is listed, do not charge a Beetle Nest. Same knobs, E24 dash and tater-pup as 18-47-09. Count nest goals after the boss appears and hp lost on those channels. Inconclusive if no boss appears.
learnings: YLS7TB at 2:08 charged a nest at 51% with amusing 242 away and telegraph underfoot. The channel ended at 2:12, hp 90 to 77, field-rat 10.1 and amusing 2.2. Five earlier nests, with no boss up, all completed at 50–63%.
